Monday Night No-Drop Road Ride (MNNDR)

Des Moines, IA · Road

No-drop

Monday Night No-Drop Road Ride (MNNDR) is a road group ride in Des Moines, IA. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Great Western Trail trailhead. About 20 miles, ~17 mph average, conversational; riders should be able to hold 14 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Monday Night No-Drop Road Ride (MNNDR) group ride

A 20-mile no-drop road ride with regroup points, led by members of a local race team. Weekly prize drawings from sponsors. Listed on the DSM Group Rides calendar alongside the Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday rides.
